first terminal row per trial ID; later attempts never improve coverage or policy fitting

metadata.canonicalRule: first terminal row per physical trial; later attempts never improve coverage
metadata.unitOfAnalysis: one base diagram within each split/family/method; candidate methods are repeated observations, not users
metadata.selectedPresetRule: same frozen selected_tuned_rows helper as portfolio analysis; p0 reuses canonical C, selected nondefault presets reuse tuning cases and supplemental runs

cohorts.completed-only: status ok, including hard-invalid completed outcomes
cohorts.hard-valid-only: status ok and frozen geometry/source-intent hard gates pass

metadata.quantileRule: p90 linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.9; descriptive small-sample tail
metadata.runtimeRule: screening descriptive/cache affected; completed/valid only; null timings remain missing; no fabricated geometry or latency for timeouts
metadata.densityAlignmentRule: saved groupFill summarized within each base; saved alignment is diagram-level, not an unmeasured group-specific statistic
metadata.witnessLedgerRule: positive observed maxima for adverse/high metrics and subunit minima for density/alignment; zero maxima remain in full summary tables; case/method/trial keys resolve raw profile links in case-metrics JSON
limitations: Four development or two heldout bases per family are too few for precise population tail claims.
Raw area, route length, and crossing counts depend on diagram size; normalized metrics and case IDs remain available.
Logical method totals contain correlated measurements and must not be interpreted as independent user counts.
Failed/timed-out/unavailable runs remain in denominator but have no fabricated completed geometry scores.
Snapshot archive details are accepted only when their saved scalar metrics match canonical rows.
Supplementary cell-access audit is separate and never changes these frozen metrics.
